spans.text: ...Under the city of Belgrade.
Bang bang bang! Ba-bang bang bang bang bang...!
More gunfire...
Detecting another battle ahead, M4 slows down and listens for a while.
...I can't hear AR-15's or AN-94's gunshots.
In that case, there's no need for me to intervene. I can simply go around it.
You've grown more prudent.
This is a rescue mission. I can't very well get myself killed as well.
Now that I'm on a solo mission, there's no room for mistakes.
Perhaps you aren't actually on your own.
I just hope you won't slow me down.
Sangvis Ferri aren't tough enemies to you since you're very familiar with them.
But the same can't be said about the White Faction, right?
I do have a general idea about them... I've received data from Ange.
I know their physical traits and how to fight them.
But what if I tell you there's an easier way...where you can beat them without even having to fight?
I'd welcome that. I don't have the ammo to spare on unnecessary foes.
...Is there actually such a convenient option?
Of course. It isn't effective against all white units, but those Nytos...
Their construction is special... Not unlike ours, actually.
Nytos... You mean the commanders of the white forces?
That's right. The other units' operation is based on manual input; your capacity may be relatively low, but seizing control over them from such a close distance should be a piece of cake for you.
But the Nytos are different. I can't sense their neural clouds. Those clones' neural pathways don't seem to be augmented with any kind of machinery at all.
You're saying...they're actually human?
More like creatures made in the image of humans. For some reason, I have a feeling that I can establish a connection with them despite the lack of a neural cloud.
In that case, I just have to catch a Nyto and you can hack her to seize command over the White Faction.
It would seem that the blocking device they're wearing on the head - the one that looks like a hairband - can block out all invasive signals.
Is there something special about the construction of their brain?
In any case, I need you to help me by destroying that blocking device.
That's stupid.
If I can fire at a Nyto's blocking device, why don't I simply blast her head open?
Even if you kill one, another will soon take over her command authorizations. I'm curious about them.
If I can set up a connection, I'm sure I'll be able to learn more.
Besides, getting our hands on a live Nyto would save us the effort of fighting through endless waves of enemies.
...It could be worth a try if we've got a chance. Hmm?
Bang bang bang! Bang bang bang bang...
Another battle...and a ferocious one. Wait, that gun sounds like...
AR-15? AN-94 is here as well...!
Realizing that her teammates are very close by, M4 breaks into a run in the direction of the gunshots.
The moment she makes a turn around the corner, she finds two muzzles pointing straight at her.
Don't shoot, it's me!
Not an enemy... Good.
AN-94 lowers her gun and leans against the wall. As she starts slumping onto the ground, AR-15 dashes to her side and supports her with a shoulder.
What's the matter? Are you hurt?
She got shot behind the right knee. We need some time to treat it.
I can't believe I let her last aimless shots get me... It's a disgrace...
Where is AK-12? Is she not with you?
She stayed behind upstairs to draw the S.F. away so that I can get to you first.
I see. It's a sound strategy.
She'll be fine on her own.
But what on earth happened here? I came across heaps of dead S.F. and white units along the way.
I'll try to keep it short, though that might be a bit difficult.
...Anyway, please try to keep calm about what I'm about to say.
...M16 is here as well?
Indeed. In fact, she seems to be the one in command in the frontlines.
She's become incredibly formidable. We alone are also no match for the various Sangvis ringleaders under her command.
Not to mention the two Nytos and the horde of white stuff that almost seem as if they can self-replicate.
I believe all we can do for now is to retreat and wait for more support.
No, it'll be too late by then.
I know you have things to sort out with her, M4, but there's only so much we can do. Just escaping alive would be...
I actually have a way to deal with the white forces. More specifically, the Nytos.
If we can take out the blocking device around a Nyto's head...
...They can be hacked?!
Well, that is a very useful piece of information, but we're being pursued by two Nytos.
Even if we get one, the other will take over command right away.
Then we get them both at the same time. We destroy both Nytos' blocking devices.
M4A1 lowers her head to think. After a few seconds of muttering, she looks up again.
Then we get them both at the same time. We destroy both Nytos' blocking devices.
Don't give them any time to react.
That's too risky. Sangvis Ferri and the White Faction are now in an all-out war fighting over the Pike Node - it's total chaos.
Firing at both Nytos under such circumstances is...
No, we can do it.
AR-15 claps M4 and AN-94 on the shoulder.
We're different than what we used to be.
I know that as long as M4 gives the order, I'll keep up.
...Right.
AN-94, just stay here and do some simple repairs on yourself. Also, fill Ange and AK-12 in on what's going on here.
You're our last fail-safe. We're counting on you.
Alright, I can see that you've made up your mind.
But here's another question - even if you manage to take down the White Faction, what are you planning to do about the remaining Sangvis forces?
I'll...have a proper word with M16.
If it can't be helped, then I'll settle everything by my own hand.
A bright fire seems to be flickering in M4's eyes.
Is that the desire for the truth...or the thirst for vengeance?
Whichever it is, AN-94 knows that she shouldn't ask any further questions...because it won't change anything.
